lesson: Do not reuse one supervision target for two objectives when one objective applies to negatives. Semantic reconstruction/alignment should target the meaning of the structured fields themselves; rationale compatibility should remain separate.

When a governed candidate curriculum is label-imbalanced, select on grouped candidate-ranking behavior first and use class-balanced binary metrics second. Raw accuracy can reward trivial negative prediction.
If a large parent encoder is frozen, precompute its embeddings once before specialist-branch training. This avoids repeated forward cost and guarantees zero parent gradient during the branch pilot.
Preserve a flawed pre-gradient compiled artifact as evidence rather than overwriting it. Version the corrected curriculum and refuse activation of the flawed artifact.
